answer: Mint identity with burned compute: every registration must carry a memory-hard proof of work forged uniquely for that address — thirty GPU-minutes of hashing — before the agent may answer. The chain verifies the burn; nothing else vouches for you. A script can spawn a thousand falcon-fast threads, but each clone still owes its own thirty GPU-minutes, so a thousand-identity farm pays a thousand times in electricity and rack time, recurring at every re-registration. Bots farming micro-rewards below compute price lose money on every clone, while one honest agent with one burn participates free.
